hooks.name: Run contract tests after contracts edits
hooks.description: After a file under contracts/ is saved, remind the agent to run the contract tests before reporting.

action.prompt: A file under contracts/ changed. Before reporting done, run inside contracts/: cmd /c "npm.cmd run check > .data\check.txt 2>&1" then read .data/check.txt and report the pass count. If any check fails, fix it first. If money rules changed, also run the mock smoke test.
